openFindings.title: Fan-out salvage appends to the lineage state log directly instead of through the append gateway
openFindings.description: The fan-out salvage sweep writes deep-review-state.jsonl directly, bypassing the append gateway, so its event is not ledger-backed, is erased by the next gateway projection refresh, and reads as a gateway-bypass violation under ledger authority.
openFindings.scopeProof: Read the full salvage path, the raw writer it calls, the projection refresh that owns the same file, the guard that detects divergence, and the merge consumer that reads the event.

openFindings.title: Two processes can both reclaim the same stale loop lock and both hold the packet lock
openFindings.description: tryReclaimStaleLoopLock can replace a fresh lock published by another reclaimer, so two concurrent acquirers can both return acquired:true and both write the same review packet.
openFindings.scopeProof: Read the full lock library, the CLI that calls it, the fence-capability consumer, the concurrency unit test, and the workflow acquire/release steps; the reclaim rename is the only unverified mutation in the lifecycle.

openFindings.title: Recursive validation silently skips a numbered child that has content but neither spec.md nor description.json
openFindings.description: Narrow the skip predicate or print the skipped numbered children in the report so a parent run cannot pass over an invalid child silently.
openFindings.scopeProof: Read the recursive loop and its skip predicate end to end, then walked the spec tree for children matched by the predicate; all observed matches are artifact-only directories.

openFindings.title: The v4.0.0.3 release shipped with a trigger index stale for its own changelog entry
openFindings.description: Regenerate the trigger index from the tagged content as part of the release tail, and rebuild it in the same commit as any changelog phrase change so --check stays green.
openFindings.scopeProof: Compared the tagged index blob with HEAD's, listed index and changelog commits in range, ran --check (exit 1) and both phrase lookups.

openFindings.title: The completion-evidence sentinel source contains a raw NUL byte, making the file binary to search and diff tooling
openFindings.description: Write the separator as the escape sequence in both files so the source stays ASCII; the runtime hash input is unchanged.
openFindings.scopeProof: Scanned every source-like file under the four focus trees for NUL bytes (two hits), read both sites in place, confirmed rg/diff/file behavior.

openFindings.title: The shipped tree lets the 033-system-speckit-v4 phase folder resolve to error under its own generated-metadata integrity gate
openFindings.description: Re-derive the folder's graph metadata with the known generate-description/backfill pair as part of the release tail.
openFindings.scopeProof: Executed the repo's checker and resolver, compared blobs across the tag, and swept 279 packets.

openFindings.title: The deep-review contract calls the config read-only after init while its own workflow flips the config status at the terminal step
openFindings.description: Scope the NEVER to review parameters (immutable after init) and name the terminal status flip as the workflow's own step.
openFindings.scopeProof: Read both sides at their exact lines; the lead ruling names the same two sides.

openFindings.title: Nine fan-out playbook scenarios name a test path that does not exist, so their exact command sequence cannot produce the result they demand
openFindings.description: Replace the nine commands with the correct deep-loop base, matching the control scenarios.
openFindings.scopeProof: Enumerated every offending occurrence, resolved the relative path, confirmed the missing directory and the present tests, read two correct-form controls.
